title: Where the band played: dance halls and lawn parties
summary: They played all over, in dance halls, at St. Elizabeth and St. Monica, and at the Royal Garden on Gravier Street.

blocks.x: Well, where did this band play mostly?
Oh, they played all over. They were playing all over the time. They were playing all over the country, but they were different places.
Did you play in many dance halls?
Oh, yeah. We played a whole lot in dance halls. But we played St. Elizabeth and St. Monica. We played at the dance hall. They called them. It's Cole, you know what? Miss Cole? Yeah.
Yeah, we played there. That rock hall. No, we played in different places.

Yeah, we played lawn parties up at the Palm Garden. We played down on Grappier Street at the Royal Garden. And we played at the Cooperator Hall and the economy. Where was the Royal Garden at? The Grappier, between Drys and Rampy, upstairs.
About what years were you with this band? Just, you know, roughly.
Well, I was with this band up there about 2021.
About 20 or 20. Yeah, around like that. So it would have been after World War I. After World War I. I see. Were you playing when the big storm came up?
